name: Mothers Love
overview: Scripture reveals a profound picture of a mother's love as both a divine blessing and a source of nurturing instruction. Children are described as a heritage and reward from the Lord, highlighting the sacredness of motherhood (Psalms 127:3). Mothers, alongside fathers, play a vital role in guiding and training their children in godly ways, ensuring their lasting faithfulness (Proverbs 1:8; 22:6). This love is marked by strength, honor, and compassion, reflecting God's own unfailing remembrance and care for His people (Proverbs 31:25; Isaiah 49:15). Honoring one's mother is commanded by God and linked to blessings and longevity (Exodus 20:12).
